programs.title: I Was Prey: Invisible Assassin
programs.desc: Diver Tim Saxon films underwater at the Great Barrier Reef and gets stung by an Irukandji jellyfish, one of the world's most venomous animals  a grizzly bear attacks forester George Knoll in the remote Great Bear Rainforest.

programs.desc: It's moving day for Acco, the zoo's biggest crocodile  all goes to plan until his mate Cassie goes into hiding  the team races to reunite the bonded pair in their new enclosure  the rescue unit fights to save a flying fox entangled in barbed wire.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Promeo, Promeo!
programs.desc: Shaun and Tom investigate whether someone who claims to be a cat's owner really is  Tom attempts to reunite a feline with his canine companion  brittle tree makes things tough on a night rescue.

programs.desc: At the zoo and the New York Aquarium, bull sea lions Clyde and Tacoma trade places to meet a new set of girlfriends  Sifaka lemurs Gemina and Andri form a new breeding pair to help their species.

programs.title: Great White Shark Babies
programs.desc: Dr. Mauricio Hoyos teams up with Michelle Jewell and Toby Daly-Engel in search of where the pregnant females of Guadalupe have their pups. Mauricio believes they go to the coast of Baja, but what they find while they're there is a Shark Week first.
